latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of launch-sentiment-sweep skill.

- Provides a one-time reaction sweep of Reddit and X (formerly Twitter) for any product launch, announcement, release, or news moment within a specified time window.
- Returns raw posts, comments, and tweets; users interpret sentiment based on the text, as no score is provided.
- Supports free API key minting with a daily trial budget; paid credits required for larger or real-time sweeps.
